build.//: This app CANNOT run in Expo Go — react-native-mmkv v4 is a Nitro module with native code. Every profile below therefore produces a real build. See apps/mobile/README.md.

preview.//: The playtester build. `distribution: internal` means an install link rather than a store submission, and `buildType: apk` makes the Android artifact directly sideloadable — a .aab cannot be installed by hand.
preview.//env: Fill to point this profile at a non-production Supabase project, or to set VITE_POSTHOG_KEY so playtest builds report analytics (they send nothing without it, and it is read at BUILD time — a build handed out without the key can't be switched on later). Unset keys fall through to the production defaults in packages/core/src/data/liveConfig.ts, so an empty env is a working production build — see apps/mobile/app.config.js.

preview-simulator.//: iOS build that runs in the Xcode Simulator without a paid Apple Developer account. Handy for reviewing screens on a Mac before enrolling.

production.//: Store submission. Android switches to .aab, which Play requires and which cannot be sideloaded.
